notes: This is an extraction plus reconstruction of hidden sides, not a detachable original object. Visible geometry/UVs are copied from the same source bale; the only new face is the flat ground-contact cap.
All material properties and embedded texture bytes are preserved. Geometry reflections are baked with corrected winding and normals; nodes use positive transforms.
Positive 90 degree yaw; bottom y0 and XZ centered. Runtime/public untouched.
